deposits.notes:
Public OSF registration titled 'Human-centered prompt engineering: creative task replication', DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/6AJKM, registered 2025-06-30. Found through the DataCite first-author search and independently through OSF registration-title search. The title, contributors, logo briefs, three DALL-E conditions, and timing match S2. The registration text supplies hypotheses, design, analysis plan, exclusions, and all 15 logo briefs.

The complete recursive file listing contains 16 files, all stimulus/interface images, in 'Archive of OSF Storage': 15 target images and apparatus_screenshot.png. The reference-image categories and names match the S1 materials described in Appendix B.4.2; these appear to be inherited project materials, not participant-generated outputs from S2. OSF reports no child registrations and no related resources; OSF Storage is the only file provider. Folder objects and the registration's structured text are not counted as files.

Downloaded all 16 files in memory without credentials; every download returned HTTP 200 and its byte count matched the API size. File signatures identify 14 JPEGs and 2 PNGs despite all filenames ending in .png. No tabular data, participant IDs, actual arm allocations, outcome records, participant prompt corpus, or replication code were present. Boolean fields concern observed participant records; the preregistration's descriptions of arms and outcomes do not count as data.

The API license relationship resolves to MIT License; node copyright metadata names 'All contributors', year 2025. This is the registration-level license. The paper separately describes third-party target-image licensing on p. 1.

The source-project relationship points to https://osf.io/ejbtp/; access to that project's metadata requires authentication. Registration field q23 cites https://osf.io/fkd25/ as the original 'Human-centered prompt engineering' registration dated December 12, 2023; that registration also requires authentication. Both are listed separately below.

Preregistration field q16 explicitly names the Bradley-Terry quality score as the primary outcome, with within-task rank and win count as secondary outcomes. This partly addresses final.open_items concerning S2's preregistration/primary-outcome hierarchy; it supplies no observed statistics. A potential audit issue is that q20 explicitly restricts user-iteration analyses to the first 10 attempts, whereas the paper calls S2's first-10 restriction non-preregistered (p. 47). The registration also plans GPT-4o-mini and exhaustive comparisons, while the PDF describes gpt-4.1-nano and sampled comparisons (pp. 49-50). These differences are recorded here without altering the screening form.

notes:
Read the entire saved markdown conversion (226,037 characters) covering all 84 PDF pages and Appendices A-I. Source: arXiv:2407.14333v7, manuscript dated January 8, 2026. Quotes were extracted from the corresponding PDF pages with PyMuPDF; line-break whitespace is normalized. The PDF has no embedded files and no working data, code, or preregistration URL; the cited registration/material URLs are replaced by anonymity placeholders. Both form.data_and_code URL fields are empty.

The current article landing page https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.14333 returned HTTP 200 and still identifies v7, last revised January 7, 2026. It provides PDF/HTML/TeX links but no specific supplementary-data deposit or journal-publication link. Generic arXiv 'Code, Data, Media' widgets are not deposited datasets. https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.14333v1 returned HTTP 200 and confirmed the older title 'As Generative Models Improve, People Adapt Their Prompts', which was also searched. The arXiv manuscript is not counted as a separate data deposit.

Status code_or_materials_only reflects the confirmed public S2 preregistration and stimulus/interface files. No public participant-level or output-level dataset with participant IDs, actual assigned arms, and outcomes was found or read. Two related OSF resources require authentication, but whether either contains participant data is unknown. The paper promises release upon publication and does not offer data on request. No identified data embargo or release date could be confirmed.

None of the missing numerical information in final.open_items can be computed from the public materials: assignment-stage allocations/attrition, human-validator counts or human-rated treatment effects, and the S1 prompt-exclusion accounting discrepancy remain unresolved. Per-person outcome means, SDs, SEs and analyzed arm counts cannot be newly computed, nor can participant-text/idea diversity. The public S2 preregistration partly resolves the separate preregistration-verification open item. Illustrative prompts/images in PDF Tables A.4-A.5 are selected examples without participant IDs and do not establish an analyzable dataset.

Search result counts are repository-reported totals, not counts of relevant deposits. relevant contains matching paper/registration URLs; the arXiv hit is a manuscript rather than data. DataCite's first-author search examined all 28 returned records and found 6ajkm. Searches of the exact current title, prior title, and discovered registration title were completed. Initial broad searches were narrowed: Harvard's unquoted title query returned 593802 hits (first 100 inspected for matching titles/authors); OSF's 'prompt' query returned 373 hits (first 100 titles inspected); Zenodo's unquoted author query returned 108 hits (first 25 inspected), followed by a creator-field query with no results. Those broad searches were not exhaustively paginated and their relevant arrays describe inspected hits only. Other similarly named results concerned different authors/studies.

All successful search requests below returned HTTP 200. Two initial Zenodo requests with size=100 returned HTTP 400 because anonymous requests permit at most 25 records per page; retries used size=25 without authentication. Their failed counts are null. OSF node searches by author use the specified title filter, so a zero count there is not a comprehensive contributor search. No GitHub repository was named by this paper, its form, or the verified registration, and no GitHub API quota was used.

Every external HTTP(S) link embedded in the saved PDF was requested with urllib and User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1; bibliographic citations and tool-documentation pages are not counted as c383 deposits. HTTP 403 bot-check responses were left as encountered, without attempting circumvention. Related OSF API/file checks and authentication failures are detailed in each deposit.
